headline: Barely knee-high and going onshore — skip today.
today: Tiny SSE dribble, glassy at dawn but not really surfable, and the S onshore builds all afternoon into evening. Nothing here worth the paddle. Save your energy for tomorrow.

daysToWatch.note: The day this week near home — prime SSE angle to 3.6ft with NE going light and glassy through the morning. Fish or shortboard, get there early before the afternoon shift.
